kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نخضوضع (form XII)
# نَخْضَوْضِعُ (naḵḍawḍiʕu) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
# نَخْضَوْضِعَ (naḵḍawḍiʕa) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
# نَخْضَوْضِعْ (naḵḍawḍiʕ) /nax.dˤaw.dˤiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
